derivation:
intro v hv
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hv
  have h := (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal Z₀).range_subschemeι
  rw [Scheme.IdealSheafData.coe_support_vanishingIdeal] at h
  exact h ⟨I.subschemeι.base z, rfl⟩
explanation: The Mathlib lemma identifies the range of an ideal sheaf's subscheme inclusion with its support. Specializing to the vanishing ideal of Z₀ identifies the range of ι Z₀ with Z₀; the map defining YI factors through ι Z₀, so its range is contained there. The current proof uses this lemma indirectly through its preceding range_ι theorem.
